scope_notice: Official formatting, anonymity, and required-section rules are separated from observational review-form metadata. Observational fields are non-binding context and must never be used as automatic acceptance thresholds or scalar score predictors.

general_empirical.label: General Empirical & Algorithmic
primary_evidence_requirements: Multi-seed dispersion or confidence intervals on main tables

systems_architecture.label: Systems & Runtime Architecture
primary_evidence_requirements: End-to-end latency distribution including P50/P95/P99 tail bounds
Explicit hardware, memory-bandwidth, and I/O boundary accounting
Inclusion of preprocessing, indexing, or fallback overhead inside timed regions

theory.label: Theoretical Analysis & Formal Proofs
primary_evidence_requirements: Complete enumeration of assumptions before each formal proposition or theorem
Proof completeness in main text or explicitly linked appendix locator
Verification that implemented algorithms satisfy theorem assumptions and degenerate limits

use_inspired.label: Use-Inspired & Domain Application
primary_evidence_requirements: Realistic operational constraints and failure-mode characterization
Domain-grounded evaluation metrics beyond synthetic proxy benchmarks

concept_feasibility.label: Concept & Feasibility Exploration
primary_evidence_requirements: Clear articulation of why existing paradigms fail on the target problem
Concrete feasibility demonstration and explicit scope limitations

negative_results.label: Negative & Diagnostic Findings
primary_evidence_requirements: Rigorous hyperparameter and implementation verification ruling out trivial bugs
Causal diagnosis of why a widely assumed hypothesis or precedent fails

review_dimensions.name: Problem Formulation & Contribution Scope
review_dimensions.core_question: Is the research question formally well-posed, and do the abstract and introduction state the contribution scope without ambiguity?

review_dimensions.name: Claim-Evidence Closure
review_dimensions.core_question: Is every quantitative or qualitative claim in the abstract, introduction, and conclusion backed by a specific proof or unconfounded empirical table/figure without scope over-generalization?

review_dimensions.name: Comparative Fairness & Counterfactual Isolation
review_dimensions.core_question: Are baselines contemporary and tuned under equal compute/token budgets, and do ablations isolate the causal contribution of each proposed component?

review_dimensions.name: Quantitative Rigor & Citation Provenance
review_dimensions.core_question: Are dispersion metrics (SD, SE, CI, p-values, effect sizes) reported and arithmetically consistent, and do cited works accurately state what is attributed to them?

review_dimensions.name: Epistemic Informativeness
review_dimensions.core_question: What non-trivial empirical law, theoretical insight, or architectural mechanism does a reader learn that was not predictable from combining existing modules?

review_dimensions.name: First-Three-Page Clarity & Notation Consistency
review_dimensions.core_question: Can a reader reconstruct the exact problem input/output, notation, and cost/threat boundaries from the first three pages without symbol collisions?

methodological_lenses.title: Abductive Minimalism & Complexity-Tax Lens
source_citations: Kaiming He et al. (2016), Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition, DOI: 10.1109/CVPR.2016.90
audit_questions: If the secondary heuristic modules are stripped away leaving only the single core mechanism, how much of the reported gain remains?
Does each added hyperparameter or architectural stage justify its complexity cost under an equal-compute baseline?
Are failure cases and performance degradations explicitly shown when assumptions are violated?

methodological_lenses.title: Systems Conservation & Tail-Latency Envelope Lens
source_citations: Jeffrey Dean and Luiz André Barroso (2013), The Tail at Scale, Communications of the ACM, DOI: 10.1145/2408776.2408794
Samuel Williams, Andrew Waterman, and David Patterson (2009), Roofline: An Insightful Visual Performance Model for Multicore Architectures, DOI: 10.1145/1498765.1498785
audit_questions: Are P95/P99 tail latencies, memory footprint, and I/O transfer hops reported alongside mean throughput?
Is any indexing, compaction, serialization, or fallback cost excluded from the timed benchmark region?
How does the system behave under resource contention, cold cache, or large-scale input growth?

methodological_lenses.title: Construct Validity & Spurious-Shortcut Falsification Lens
source_citations: Zachary C. Lipton and Jacob Steinhardt (2019), Troubling Trends in Machine Learning Scholarship, Queue / CACM, DOI: 10.1145/3318231
ACL Rolling Review Reviewer Guidelines (2026), Issue Taxonomy Codes M1-M5, R1-R5, G1-G5
audit_questions: Do the chosen benchmarks actually measure the high-level construct claimed in the title and abstract, or only a narrow dataset distribution?
Could data leakage, prompt-tuning asymmetry, or a lexical/recency shortcut explain the observed improvement?
Are all citations verified against primary texts so no prior work is straw-manned or misattributed?

methodological_lenses.title: Formal Well-Posedness & Degenerate-Boundary Lens
source_citations: NeurIPS 2026 Reviewer Guidelines — Theory Contribution Track Criteria
Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR) Evaluation Criteria on Claim-Evidence Accuracy
audit_questions: Does the actual code implementation strictly satisfy the assumptions stated in the formal propositions or theorems?
Are symbols, domains, quantifiers, and objective functions defined before first use without notation overloading?
What happens at asymptotic or degenerate boundaries (empty history, adversarial shift, extreme budget constraints)?

official_guideline_rules: Initial submission main text is strictly limited to 9 pages; during discussion/rebuttal and camera-ready phases the limit rises to 10 pages.
References and appendices do not count toward the main-body page limit; Ethics and Reproducibility statements are recommended and exempt from page count.
Use of LLMs must be disclosed where required by the call for papers; reviewers focus on the 1-2 decisive factors driving the recommendation.

neurips.display_name: Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS)
official_guideline_rules: Submissions declare a locked Contribution Type: General, Theory, Use-Inspired, Concept & Feasibility, or Negative Results.
Quality, Clarity, Significance, and Originality (1-4) are interpreted conditionally on the selected Contribution Type.
Reviewers state explicit, actionable criteria under which their assessment could improve during the author rebuttal.

official_guideline_rules: Main text is limited to 8 pages in double-column format; references and appendices may follow on additional pages.
Submissions must include an Impact Statement section (which does not count toward the 8-page limit if placed after main text as instructed).

observed_form_metadata.2026_scale: Overall Recommendation {1: Strong Reject .. 6: Strong Accept}

acl.display_name: Association for Computational Linguistics / ACL Rolling Review (ARR)
official_guideline_rules: Mandatory dedicated Limitations section; omission is grounds for desk rejection.
Soundness (objective technical validity) is evaluated orthogonally from Excitement (subjective taste).
Low soundness assessments must be justified by concrete evidence and issue codes (M1-M5, R1-R5, G1-G5, T1-T2).

official_guideline_rules: Uses ACM sigconf two-column template with anonymous=true for double-blind review tracks.
